improved_healing_wave.name: Improved Healing Wave
improved_healing_wave.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by [V1] sec.

totemic_focus.name: Totemic Focus
totemic_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your totems by [V1]%.

improved_reincarnation.name: Improved Reincarnation
improved_reincarnation.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Reincarnation spell by [V1] min and increases the amount of health and mana recovered when reincarnating by an additional [V2]%.

healing_grace.name: Healing Grace
healing_grace.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by [V1]% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled by [V2]%.

tidal_focus.name: Tidal Focus
tidal_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your healing spells by [V1]%.

improved_water_shield.name: Improved Water Shield
improved_water_shield.tooltipTemplate: You have a [V1]% chance to instantly gain mana as if you consumed a Water Shield Orb when you gain a critical effect from your Healing Wave or Riptide spells and a [V2]% chance when you gain a critical effect from your Lesser Healing Wave or Chain Heal spells.

healing_focus.name: Healing Focus
healing_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting any Shaman healing spell by [V1]%.

tidal_force.name: Tidal Force
tidal_force.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave and Chain Heal by 60%. Each critical heal reduces the chance by 20%. Lasts 20 sec.

ancestral_healing.name: Ancestral Healing
ancestral_healing.tooltipTemplate: Reduces your target's physical damage taken by [V1]% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.

restorative_totems.name: Restorative Totems
restorative_totems.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by [V1]%, and increases the amount healed by your Healing Stream Totem by [V2]%.

tidal_mastery.name: Tidal Mastery
tidal_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing and lightning spells by [V1]%.

healing_way.name: Healing Way
healing_way.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by [V1]%.

natures_swiftness.name: Nature's Swiftness
natures_swiftness.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your next Nature spell with a base casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell. Nature's Swiftness shares a cooldown with Elemental Mastery.

focused_mind.name: Focused Mind
focused_mind.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effects used against the Shaman by [V1]%. This effect does not stack with other similar effects.

purification.name: Purification
purification.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by [V1]%.

natures_guardian.name: Nature's Guardian
natures_guardian.tooltipTemplate: Whenever a damaging attack brings you below 30% health, your maximum health is increased by [V1]% for 10 sec and your threat level towards the attacker is reduced.  30 second cooldown.

mana_tide_totem.name: Mana Tide Totem
mana_tide_totem.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 10% of the caster's health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 5% of total mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

cleanse_spirit.name: Cleanse Spirit
cleanse_spirit.tooltipTemplate: Cleanse the spirit of a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 curse effect.

blessing_of_the_eternals.name: Blessing of the Eternals
blessing_of_the_eternals.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your spells by [V1]%, and increases the chance to apply the Earthliving heal over time effect on the target by [V2]% when they are at or under 50% total health.

improved_chain_heal.name: Improved Chain Heal
improved_chain_heal.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Chain Heal spell by [V1]%.

natures_blessing.name: Nature's Blessing
natures_blessing.tooltipTemplate: Increases your healing by an amount equal to [V1]% of your Intellect.

ancestral_awakening.name: Ancestral Awakening
ancestral_awakening.tooltipTemplate: When you critically heal with your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave or Riptide you summon an Ancestral spirit to aid you, instantly healing the lowest percentage health friendly party or raid target within 40 yards for [V1]% of the amount healed.

earth_shield.name: Earth Shield
earth_shield.tooltipTemplate: Protects the target with an earthen shield, reducing casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30%  and causing attacks to heal the shielded target for 123.  This effect can only occur once every few seconds.  6 charges.  Lasts 10 min.  Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time and only one Elemental Shield can be active on a target at a time.

improved_earth_shield.name: Improved Earth Shield
improved_earth_shield.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of charges for your Earth Shield by [V1], and increases the healing done by your Earth Shield by [V2]%.

tidal_waves.name: Tidal Waves
tidal_waves.tooltipTemplate: When you cast Chain Heal or Riptide, you have a [V1]% chance to lower the cast time of your Healing Wave spell by 30% and increase the critical effect chance of your Lesser Healing Wave spell by 25%, until two such spells have been cast. In addition, your Healing Wave gains an additional [V2]% of your bonus healing effects and your Lesser Healing Wave gains an additional [V3]% of your bonus healing effects.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 456 and another 480 over 15 sec.  Your next Chain Heal cast on that primary target within 15 sec will consume the healing over time effect and increase the amount of the Chain Heal by 25%.

convection.name: Convection
convection.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock, Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst, and Wind Shear spells by [V1]%.

concussion.name: Concussion
concussion.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Thunderstorm, Lava Burst and Shock spells by [V1]%.

call_of_flame.name: Call of Flame
call_of_flame.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire Totems and Fire Nova by [V1]%, and damage done by your Lava Burst spell by [V2]%.

elemental_devastation.name: Elemental Devastation
elemental_devastation.tooltipTemplate: Your non-periodic offensive spell crits will increase your chance to get a critical strike with melee attacks by [V1]% for 10 sec.

reverberation.name: Reverberation
reverberation.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock and Wind Shear spells by 1 sec.

elemental_focus.name: Elemental Focus
elemental_focus.tooltipTemplate: After landing a non-periodic critical strike with a Fire, Frost, or Nature damage spell, you enter a Clearcasting state.  The Clearcasting state reduces the mana cost of your next 3 damage or healing spells by 40%.

elemental_fury.name: Elemental Fury
elemental_fury.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by [V1]%.

improved_fire_nova.name: Improved Fire Nova
improved_fire_nova.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova by [V1]% and reduces its cost by [V2]% and the cooldown by [V3] sec.

eye_of_the_storm.name: Eye of the Storm
eye_of_the_storm.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the pushback suffered from damaging attacks while casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Burst and Hex spells by [V1]%.

elemental_reach.name: Elemental Reach
elemental_reach.tooltipTemplate: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Fire Nova, and Lava Burst spells by [V1] yards, increases the radius of your Thunderstorm spell by [V2]%, and increases the range of your Flame Shock by [V3] yards.

call_of_thunder.name: Call of Thunder
call_of_thunder.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Thunderstorm spells by an additional 5%.

unrelenting_storm.name: Unrelenting Storm
unrelenting_storm.tooltipTemplate: Regenerate mana equal to [V1]% of your Intellect every 5 sec, even while casting.

elemental_precision.name: Elemental Precision
elemental_precision.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit with Fire, Frost and Nature spells by [V1]% and reduces the threat caused by Fire, Frost and Nature spells by [V2]%.

lightning_mastery.name: Lightning Mastery
lightning_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by [V1] sec.

elemental_mastery.name: Elemental Mastery
elemental_mastery.tooltipTemplate: When activated, your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or Lava Burst spell becomes an instant cast spell. In addition, you gain 15% spell haste for 15 sec. Elemental Mastery shares a cooldown with Nature's Swiftness.

storm_earth_and_fire.name: Storm, Earth and Fire
storm_earth_and_fire.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Chain Lightning spell by 2.5 sec, your Earthbind Totem also has a 100% chance to root targets for 5 sec when cast and the periodic damage done by your Flame Shock is increased by 60%.

booming_echoes.name: Booming Echoes
booming_echoes.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Shock spells by an additional [V1] sec and increases the direct damage done by them by an additional [V2]%.

elemental_oath.name: Elemental Oath
elemental_oath.tooltipTemplate: While Clearcasting from Elemental Focus is active, you deal [V1]% more spell damage. In addition, party and raid members within 100 yards receive a [V2]% bonus to their spell critical strike chance.

lightning_overload.name: Lightning Overload
lightning_overload.tooltipTemplate: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a [V1]% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

astral_shift.name: Astral Shift
astral_shift.tooltipTemplate: When stunned, feared or silenced you  shift into the Astral Plane reducing all damage taken by [V1]% for the duration of the stun, fear or silence effect.

totem_of_wrath.name: Totem of Wrath
totem_of_wrath.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Totem of Wrath with 5 health at the feet of the caster.  The totem increases spell power by 100 for all party and raid members, and increases the critical strike chance of all attacks by 3% against all enemies within 40 yards.  Lasts 5 min.

lava_flows.name: Lava Flows
lava_flows.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Lava Burst spell by an additional [V1]%, and when your Flame Shock is dispelled your spell casting speed is increased by [V2]% for 6 sec.

shamanism.name: Shamanism
shamanism.tooltipTemplate: Your Lightning Bolt and Lava Burst spells gain an additional [V1]% and your Chain Lightning gains an additional [V2]% of your bonus damage effects.

thunderstorm.name: Thunderstorm
thunderstorm.tooltipTemplate: You call down a bolt of lightning, energizing you and damaging nearby enemies within 10 yards. Restores 15% mana to you and deals 551 to 629 Nature damage to all nearby enemies, knocking them back 20 yards. This spell is usable while stunned.

enhancing_totems.name: Enhancing Totems
enhancing_totems.tooltipTemplate: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Flametongue Totems by [V1]%.

earths_grasp.name: Earth's Grasp
earths_grasp.tooltipTemplate: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by [V1]% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by [V2]%, and reduces the cooldown of both totems by [V3]%.

totemic_bond.name: Totemic Bond
totemic_bond.tooltipTemplate:
Using Stoneclaw Totem while Earthen Guardian is active has a 100% chance to reduce all damage taken by 20% for 6 seconds.  

In addition, 100% of the threat generated by the damage of your Searing Totem and Magma Totem will be redirected to you instead.

guardian_totems.name: Guardian Totems
guardian_totems.tooltipTemplate: Increases the amount of armor increased by your Stoneskin Totem by [V1]% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by [V2] sec.

thundering_strikes.name: Thundering Strikes
thundering_strikes.tooltipTemplate: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by [V1]%.

improved_ghost_wolf.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
improved_ghost_wolf.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by [V1] sec.

improved_shields.name: Improved Shields
improved_shields.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by [V1]%, increases the amount of mana gained from your Water Shield orbs by [V2]% and increases the amount of healing done by your Earth Shield orbs by [V3]%.

elemental_weapons.name: Elemental Weapons
elemental_weapons.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage caused by your Windfury Weapon effect by [V1]%  increases the spell damage on your Flametongue Weapon by [V2]% and increases the bonus healing on your Earthliving Weapon by [V3]%.

lava_lash.name: Lava Lash
lava_lash.tooltipTemplate:
You charge your off-hand weapon with lava, instantly dealing 100% off-hand Weapon damage. Damage is increased by 25% if your off-hand weapon is enchanted with Flametongue.

Also teaches you Dual Wield.@s:1100674:0:s@

shamanistic_focus.name: Shamanistic Focus
shamanistic_focus.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock spells by 45%.

anticipation.name: Anticipation
anticipation.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional [V1]%, and reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you by [V2]%. This does not stack with other Disarm duration reducing effects.

flurry.name: Flurry
flurry.tooltipTemplate: Increases your attack speed by [V1]% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

toughness.name: Toughness
toughness.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Stamina by [V1]%, and reduces the duration of movement slowing effects on you by [V2]%.

improved_windfury_totem.name: Improved Windfury Totem
improved_windfury_totem.tooltipTemplate: Increases the melee haste granted by your Windfury totem by [V1]%.

spirit_weapons.name: Spirit Weapons
spirit_weapons.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all threat generated by 30% and increases damage done by your Windfury and Flametongue Weapon Enhancements by 5%.

mental_dexterity.name: Mental Dexterity
mental_dexterity.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Attack Power by [V1]% of your Intellect and your chance to hit with spells by [V2]%.

earthen_attunement.name: Earthen Attunement
earthen_attunement.tooltipTemplate: While Earthen Guardian is active you take 6% less physical damage and 9% less spell damage. In addition, dealing physical damage reduces the target's attack power by -169.

unleashed_rage.name: Unleashed Rage
unleashed_rage.tooltipTemplate: Increases your Expertise by [V1], and increases all party and raid members' attack power by [V2]% while within 100 yards of the Shaman.

weapon_mastery.name: Weapon Mastery
weapon_mastery.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage you deal with all weapons by [V1]%.

frozen_power.name: Frozen Power
frozen_power.tooltipTemplate: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Lash and Shock spells by [V1]% on targets afflicted by your Frostbrand Attack effect, and your Frost Shock has a [V2]% chance to root the target in ice for 5 sec. when used on targets at or further than 15 yards from you.

dual_wield_specialization.name: Dual Wield Specialization
dual_wield_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases your chance to hit while dual wielding by an additional [V1]%.

two_handed_weapon_specialization.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
two_handed_weapon_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases your critical strike chance while wielding a Two-Handed Weapon by an additional [V1]% and increases the damage dealt by Stormstrike by [V2]%.

stormstrike.name: Stormstrike
stormstrike.tooltipTemplate: Instantly attack with both weapons.  In addition, the next 4 sources of Nature damage dealt to the target from the Shaman are increased by 20%. Lasts 12 sec.

shield_specialization.name: Shield Specialization
shield_specialization.tooltipTemplate: Increases your armor value from your equipped Shield by [V1]% and reduces the chance you'll be critically hit by melee attacks by [V2]%.

static_shock.name: Static Shock
static_shock.tooltipTemplate: You have a chance ([V1] PPM) to hit your target with a Lightning Shield orb charge when you deal damage with melee attacks and abilities, and your Lightning Shield gains [V2] additional charges.

spirit_guard.name: Spirit Guard
spirit_guard.tooltipTemplate: You gain Block Rating equal to your Agility. Ancestral spirits strengthen your shield, further reducing damage taken by blocked attacks by 15%.

improved_stormstrike.name: Improved Stormstrike
improved_stormstrike.tooltipTemplate: When you Stormstrike, you have a [V1]% chance to immediately grant you 20% of your base mana.

mental_quickness.name: Mental Quickness
mental_quickness.tooltipTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast Shaman spells by [V1]% and increases your spell power by an amount equal to [V2]% of your attack power.

shamanistic_rage.name: Shamanistic Rage
shamanistic_rage.tooltipTemplate: Reduces all damage taken by 30% and gives your successful melee attacks a chance to regenerate mana equal to 15% of your attack power. This spell is usable while stunned. Lasts 15 sec.

earthen_power.name: Earthen Power
earthen_power.tooltipTemplate: Your Earthbind Totem's pulses have a [V1]% chance to also remove all snare effects from you and nearby friendly targets, and your Earth Shock reduces enemy attack speed by an additional [V2]%.

maelstrom_weapon.name: Maelstrom Weapon
maelstrom_weapon.tooltipTemplate: When you deal damage with a melee weapon, you have a chance (higher than rank 2) to reduce the cast time of your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lesser Healing Wave, Healing Wave, Chain Heal, or Hex spell by 20%. Stacks up to 8 times. Consumes 5 at a time. Lasts 30 sec.

feral_spirit.name: Feral Spirit
feral_spirit.tooltipTemplate: Summons two Spirit Wolves under the command of the Shaman, lasting 45 sec.

enchants.name: Astral Plane
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Astral Plane.
Astral Plane: Partially shift into the astral plane reducing damage taken by -30% for 15 sec. As time passes, you slowly converge back to reality, lowering the damage reduction.

enchants.name: Capacitor Totem
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Capacitor Totem. 
Capacitor Totem: Summons an Air totem with 5 health within 25 yards that gathers electrical energy from the surrounding air and then explodes after 2 sec to deal Nature damage and stun all enemies within 8 yards for 4 sec.

enchants.name: Earthquake
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Earthquake. 
Earthquake: You cause the earth at the target location to tremble and break, dealing Nature damage every 1 sec to enemies and reducing their movement speed by 25% in an 8 yard radius. Lasts 8 sec. 

Enemies taking damage from it are affected with Trembling and on 3 stacks they get stunned for 3 seconds. This can only occur every 10 sec from any Earthquake effect.

enchants.name: Spirit Link Totem
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Spirit Link Totem
Spirit Link Totem: Summons an Air Totem with 5 health within 25 yards. The totem redistributes the health of all party and raid members within 10 yards every 1 sec, such that each player ends up with the same percentage of their maximum health. Lasts 8 sec.

enchants.name: Spiritwalker's Grace
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Spiritwalker's Grace. 
Spiritwalker's Grace: Calls upon the guidance of the spirits for 12 sec, allowing movement while casting Shaman spells and granting Spiritwalker's Determination.

Castable while casting other spells.
Spiritwalker's Determination: Immune to Interrupt and Silence mechanics. Lasts 5 sec or until next spell with a cast time is used.

enchants.name: Sundering
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Sundering. 
Sundering: Shatters a line of earth in front of you, causing 948 Fire damage and Incapacitating any enemy hit for 4 sec. This effect does not break from Flame Shock periodic damage.

enchants.name: Windwalk Totem
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Windwalk Totem. 
Windwalk Totem: Summons an Air Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 sec, increasing the movement speed of party members within 40 yards by 40%.

enchants.name: Ascending Flames
enchants.tooltip: The initial damage of Flame Shock is increased by 50% when cast on a target already afflicted by it. Casting Flame Shock reduces the cooldown of Flame Ascendance by 5 sec and Lava Burst by 2 sec.

enchants.name: Cataclysmic Sundering
enchants.tooltip:
Using Sundering leaves a burning patch of lava on the ground, dealing 119.48 Fire damage to enemies every second over 4 sec.

When Sundering deals damage to a creature the cooldown of Sundering is reduced by 0 seconds and causes your next Lava Burst to be instant cast.

Sundering no longer incapacitates creatures.

enchants.name: Charged Tides
enchants.tooltip: Casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning on a monster reduces the cast time and mana cost of your next Chain Heal or Healing Wave by 20%, stacking up to 3 times.

enchants.name: Clear Mind
enchants.tooltip: Your Elemental Focus Clearcasting gains an extra charge and grants 3% spell haste.

enchants.name: Cloudburst Totem
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Cloudburst Totem. 
Cloudburst Totem: Summons a totem at your feet with 5 health for 15 sec that collects power from all of your healing spells. When the totem expires or dies, the stored power is released, healing all injured allies within 40 yards for 40% of all Nature healing done while it was active.

Casting this spell a second time recalls the totem and releases the healing.

enchants.name: Converging Elements
enchants.tooltip:
Increases the damage and critical chance of your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 20%.

Damage from Flametongue Weapon or Frostbrand Weapon has a 25% chance to grant Converging Elements, causing your next Stormstrike within 12 sec to trigger no cooldown. This can not occur more than once every 4 sec.

enchants.name: Crackling Flames
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning or any Shock spell reduces the current cooldown of Fire Nova by 1 second.

It also increases the damage of your next Fire Nova by 15% and reduces its cost by 15%. Lasts 10 sec. Stacks 5 times.

enchants.name: Defense of Thundarian
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Windfury grants you Defense of Thundarian.
Defense of Thundarian: Reduces your magic damage taken by 3% and increases your armor by 10%. Lasts 6 sec.

enchants.name: Dynamic Charge
Earthen Grace
enchants.tooltip: Increases your Nature healing done by 8% on allies affected by your Earthliving healing over time effect and extends the duration of your Earthliving healing over time effect by 6 sec.

enchants.name: Earthen Spike
Electric Surge
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Flurry
Casting Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning triggers the highest known rank of your Flurry talent.

Flurry now gains 2 additional charges and grants an additional 10% attack speed.
@s:1116256:0:s@

enchants.name: Elemental Blast
enchants.tooltip:
Teaches you: Elemental Blast. 
Elemental Blast: Harness and direct the raw power of the elements towards an enemy target, dealing Elemental damage and increasing the caster's critical strike chance or spell casting speed for 8 seconds.

enchants.name: Elemental Equilibrium
enchants.tooltip: Dealing direct damage with a Fire, Frost, and Nature spell within 10 seconds increases your damage with these schools by 8% for 10 sec.

enchants.name: Elemental Harmony
enchants.tooltip: Healing an ally to full health makes your next Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning cost no mana. Lasts 30 sec. Holds up to 3 charges.

enchants.name: Elemental Momentum
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Elemental Focus
Killing an opponent that yields experience or honor triggers your Elemental Focus talent.

While Clearcasting from Elemental Focus is active, your Lightning Bolt has 15% increased critical strike chance.

enchants.name: Forked Lightning
enchants.tooltip: Chain Lightning zaps the target and while a nearby enemy exists, a fork of lightning jumps between the target and the nearby enemy dealing ${23*0.99+0*0.01713)} Nature damage every second for 5 seconds.

enchants.name: Frugal Disposition
enchants.tooltip: When you overheal with Healing Wave or Lesser Healing Wave, your target receives half the overhealing periodically over 6 seconds.

enchants.name: Fury of the Wind
enchants.tooltip:
Your Windfury Weapon can jump to 2 nearby enemies but each jump reduces its damage by 25%.

If no other enemies are nearby the wind jumps to you instead, increasing your physical damage by 20% (10% vs players) and attack speed by 20% for 20 sec.

enchants.name: Healing Tide
enchants.tooltip: Placing Healing Stream Totem will release an initial pulse healing nearby allies for 349. Your Healing Stream Totem healing is also doubled for 20 sec after being placed, but Healing Stream Totem now has a 20 second cooldown.

enchants.name: Hydromancer: Conductor
enchants.tooltip: Dealing damage with Water Bolt or Frost Shock increases your chance to trigger Lightning Overload by 10%, stacking 3 times. Lasts for 8 sec.

enchants.name: Hydromancer: Water Nova
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Frost Shock on an enemy leaves behind a pool of splashing water for 6 sec, dealing 146.14 Frost damage to nearby enemies over time.

Dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning, electrifies the water, causing it to deal 489.77 Nature damage over 6 sec.

enchants.name: Lava Burn
enchants.tooltip: When Lava Burst critically strikes, you burn the target for an additional 15% of the damage dealt over 8 sec.

enchants.name: Lava Ignition
enchants.tooltip:
Your Lava Lash deals 30% increased damage on targets affected by your Flame Shock.

Using Lava Lash refreshes your Flame Shock duration on the target and spreads it to 4 enemies.

enchants.name: Leader of the Elements
enchants.tooltip:
Casting Stormstrike, Lava Lash and Wind Lash reduces the cooldown of your Greater Elemental Totems by 10 seconds.

Casting any Shaman Shock spell grants Leader of the Elements.
Leader of the Elements: Increases the damage your Greater Elementals deal by 15%. Stacks up to 3 times. Lasts 10 sec.

enchants.name: Lightning Fangs
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Feral Spirit
Using Stormstrike charges your Spirit Wolves with lightning, causing their auto attacks to deal extra Nature damage for 6 seconds.

enchants.name: Lightning Strikes Twice
enchants.tooltip: Removes the cooldown on Chain Lightning but reduces its damage by 25%.

enchants.name: Low Tide
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Riptide
Increases your chance to critically heal your Riptide target by 8%. 

Critical heals with Healing Wave on your Riptide target now spread Riptide to a nearby ally.

enchants.name: Mastery of Lightning
enchants.tooltip:
The proc chance of the Lightning Overload talent is now doubled on critical strikes.

In addition, dealing damage with Lightning Bolt or Chain Lightning reduces the cooldown of Elemental Mastery 2 seconds.

enchants.name: Mastery of the Tide
enchants.tooltip: Reduces the cast time of your Chain Heal by 10% and makes it no longer consume Riptide.

enchants.name: Molten Outburst
enchants.tooltip:
Dealing damage with Lava Burst against an enemy in your Earthquake causes an eruption, dealing 714.9 Fire damage to nearby enemies.

Earthquake no longer costs any mana and deals 50% increased damage.

enchants.name: Nature's Flow
Pack Alpha
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Feral Spirit
Dealing damage with Stormstrike, Lava Lash or Wind Lash versus monsters reduces Feral Spirit's cooldown by 0 seconds.

enchants.name: Pendulum
enchants.tooltip: Receive 3% spell haste while above 50% mana and 3% spell critical strike chance while below 50% mana.

enchants.name: Primal Tide
Primordial Aftershocks
enchants.tooltip: Casting Lava Burst, Elemental Blast or Lava Beam resets the cooldown of your Shock spells.

enchants.name: Resurgent Waves
enchants.tooltip:
Your Lesser Healing Wave and Healing Wave has an additional 15% critical strike chance and restores 5% base mana and a charge of Water Shield when healing an ally below 50% health.

Water Shield can now hold 2 more charges.

enchants.name: Shock Tactics
enchants.tooltip: Increases the critical strike chance of your Shock spells by 15%. Your Shock spells reduce the cast time of your next Lightning Bolt of Healing Wave by 0.5 sec.

enchants.name: Stoneclaw
enchants.tooltip:
Requires Earthen Guardian
Increases your attack power by 1 for every ${$10000-9699} armor you have and increases your threat by 15%.

Teaches you: Stoneclaw.
Stoneclaw: Empowers your next 3 main hand hits to deal extra high threat 158.86 Nature damage to nearby enemies.

Shares a cooldown with Stoneclaw Totem and can trigger Glyph of Stoneclaw Totem and Totemic Bond.

enchants.name: Stormborn
Tethered Power
enchants.tooltip:
Your Tethered Elemental's critical strikes grant you Elemental Air.

Casting Elemental Blast grants Elemental Synergy.
Elemental Air: Reduces the cooldown of Elemental Blast by 1 sec, this can only occur once every 2 seconds.

Damage and critical strike chance of your next Elemental Blast is increased by 30%.
Elemental Synergy: Increases the damage your Elemental deals by 8%. Stacks up to 5. Lasts 20 seconds.

abilities.tooltipTemplate: Cleanse the spirit of a friendly target, removing 1 poison effect, 1 disease effect, and 1 curse effect.

abilities.name: Cleansing Totem
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Cleansing Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that attempts to remove 1 disease and 1 poison effect from party members within 30 yards every 3 seconds.  Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Cure Toxins
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Cures 1 poison effect and 1 disease effect on a friendly target.

abilities.name: Earth Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Protects the target with an earthen shield, reducing casting or channeling time lost when damaged by 30%  and causing attacks to heal the shielded target for 123.  This effect can only occur once every few seconds.  6 charges.  Lasts 10 min.  Earth Shield can only be placed on one target at a time and only one Elemental Shield can be active on a target at a time.

abilities.name: Earthliving Weapon
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Imbue the Shaman's weapon with earthen life. Increases healing done by 70 and each heal has a 20% chance to proc Earthliving on the target, healing an additional 252 over 12 sec. Lasts 30 minutes.

abilities.name: Healing Stream Totem
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Healing Stream Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that heals group members within 30 yards for 14 every 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Healing Wave
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 1167.

abilities.name: Lesser Healing Wave
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 600.

abilities.name: Mana Spring Totem
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Mana Spring Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 5 min that restores 31 mana every 5 seconds to all party and raid members within 30 yards.

abilities.name: Riptide
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Heals a friendly target for 456 and another 480 over 15 sec.  Your next Chain Heal cast on that primary target within 15 sec will consume the healing over time effect and increase the amount of the Chain Heal by 25%.

abilities.name: Tidal Force
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave and Chain Heal by 60%. Each critical heal reduces the chance by 20%. Lasts 20 sec.

abilities.name: Totemic Projection
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Calls your active totems to your active location.

abilities.name: Totemic Recall
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Returns your totems to the earth, giving you 75% of the mana required to cast each totem destroyed by Totemic Recall.

abilities.name: Tremor Totem
abilities.tooltipTemplate: Summons a Tremor Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster that shakes the ground around it, removing Fear, Charm and Sleep effects from party members within 30 yards.  Lasts 5 min.

abilities.name: Water Shield
abilities.tooltipTemplate: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water, granting 38 mana per 5 sec.  When a spell, melee or ranged attack hits the caster, 162 mana is restored to the caster. This expends one water globe.  Only one globe will activate every few seconds.  Lasts 10 min.  Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.
